note: What convert_lizards.py needs to know about the four Greys frigates, ai models/greys-*-frigate.glb, in the layout of lizard_spec.json (read its note). The saucers have no long axis, so each is turned by a chosen angle (turn, degrees about Z, after levelling the disc with up = its smallest principal axis where the model came tilted) to put the chosen front at -X: the Scout's hatch bump, the Reaper's widest gap between legs, the Shroud's dish (facing forward over the bow); the Lance (a manta) has its pointed nose forward. The frame is then as for the Vrask: bow at -X, +Z up, keel on z = 0, 1 unit long (the saucers' diameter), centred in X and Y; boxes are [x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1], +Y starboard. No nozzles are modelled: the engines are put on the after rim (saucers) or the glowing pods under the tail (Lance). The hulls are one piece with nothing that reads as a turret, so there are fixed guns and role points only. Measured with align_grid.py (gridded views, --probe ray hits, --islands) and checked with its --marks renders.

ships.notes: Plain domed saucer with a glowing blue rim line, a small dome on top (the sensor), a matching hatch bump forward on the top and the underside (precision beam emitters) and a flat disc under the middle. The source is tilted ~11 deg; levelled by up.

Rough saucer with a big bowl dish on a short mast (aft of the middle, tilted to face forward and up: the jammer), a flat dish forward to starboard (the sensor), a tall blade fin forward to port, a glowing eye in the middle of the top, a round gondola hanging under the middle (the EMP projector) and a swept tail spike aft to port.

Manta: a pointed nose with long glowing violet slots along its top and flanks (the energy guns, one fixed battery), broad swept wings, a domed canopy amidships, the underside open in violet-lit pockets, and two glowing pods under the tail (the drives). The source is pitched ~9 deg; levelled by up.

Deep saucer with a domed top, a stepped underside ending in a round pod (the abduction bay) and seven jointed grappling legs around it; the widest gap between legs is put forward. Tractor emitters at the tips of the two forward legs and the two side legs; light guns on the forward rim.
